issue.title: Reconcile widespread ACE PNG snapshot drift
issue.description: Discovered while running just test for sase-bp; also proposed in closed phase sase-bv.4. The full suite has 53 PNG golden mismatches across Config Center, inventory picker, models alias picker, and renamed family-root views. None involve files changed by sase-bp. Inspect the generated expected/actual/diff artifacts under .pytest_cache/sase-visual, determine whether the current rendering is intentional, update only intentional goldens, and rerun just test-visual.
